<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 131.87, 129.70 (two peaks), 129.01 (two peaks), and 129.00 ppm. That gives a total of 6 aromatic carbon signals, indicating the compound contains six aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
